maria: quick check — since the sampler change rolled out yesterday, prefetche r traces are mostly missing. root spans exist but child spans for the worker tasks are gone. anyone seen this pattern before?
ben: do you have a trace id or a small log snippet? could be sampling prob or context propagation break.
maria: trace id 0af3c7b2... grabbing a tiny log excerpt:

```
2026-03-15T14:22:08Z prefetcher INFO starting fetch batch=54 trace_id=0af3c7b2
2026-03-15T14:22:08Z prefetcher WARNING otel: sampler decision: drop
2026-03-15T14:22:09Z prefetcher INFO fetch complete batch=54
```

kai: that WARNING is the giveaway — sampler decided to drop. we pushed a lower global ratio yesterday as part of the cost cleanup. @ben did we change the helms values for background workers?
ben: yep, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG went from 0.2 -> 0.01 in helm for background-workers. intended to cut ingestion costs but a bit aggressive for debugging prefetcher flows :grimacing: 
priya: for quick debug flip sampling to full for a short window on staging:

```
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=1.0
```

kubectl set env deploy/prefetcher OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=1.0

infra-bot: traces dashboard shortcut: https://grafana.internal.redwood/traces?service=prefetcher&from=now-1h — use the search box to paste the trace id :mag: 

maria: i'll flip staging and run two sample jobs, report back. ben — can you open a tiny revert PR for prod sampler arg while we validate?
ben: opening small revert PR now, linking in infra helm charts: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/helm-charts/pulls/1235 — will mark as hotfix if we revert within 30m. adding a line in changelog about cost vs visibility.
kai: i'll do a quick review of that PR. also, once we enable higher sampling, let's watch tail latency and ingestion metrics — increased sampling can spike ingest for short windows. i can run an export of a few spans to s3 for the oncall runbook.
maria: thanks. also where do folks look for trace->log correlation? i thought we map req_id into span attributes but can't find the snippet.
priya: docs live in observability repo: https://git.internal.redwood/docs/observability/traces-logs.md — search for `req_id` mapping. short tip: paste trace id into Grafana traces, open the span details, then click the linked logs panel to filter by req_id.
ben: small SDK note — if you're using python workers make sure contextvars propagation is enabled. sample init we recommend: 

```python
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.sampling import TraceIdRatioBased

provider = TracerProvider(sampler=TraceIdRatioBased(float(os.getenv('OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG', '0.01'))))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
# ensure any async tasks use contextvars so spans don't get orphaned
```

maria: that matches our code. i'll confirm staging picks up env override, run the jobs, then if ok we'll merge ben's revert for prod. i'll post results here.
ben: PR is up and pinged @kai and @priya for quick review. will add a note in the release artifacts about the sampler rollback and the reasoning.
infra-bot: reminder: for retrospective create an incident with tag `observability` so we capture cost vs observability tradeoffs in one place :memo: 
maria: updating — staging now shows child spans restored after sampling flip. i'll attach a couple of trace ids in a minute and then we can coordinate the prod revert. thanks all.
ben: thanks :rocket:
